data.name: PageDescription
data.value: View load plans and create a load plan from existing carrier and shipment references.

data.name: CarrierIdHelp
data.value: The carrier’s UUID. It must be an active carrier that supports the selected mode.

data.name: ShipmentIdsHelp
data.value: At least one shipment UUID. Shipments must be Draft or Planned; the order you enter is kept.

data.name: PlannedDepartAtHelp
data.value: Your local date and time. It is sent in UTC.

data.name: PlannedDepartAtInvalid
data.value: Enter a valid date and time that exists in your time zone.

data.name: StopsHelp
data.value: At least two stops, numbered 1 to N, with at least one Pickup and one Delivery.

data.name: ListUnavailable
data.value: Loads could not be loaded. Try again later.

data.name: ValidationError
data.value: Check the entered values and try again.

data.name: AccessDenied
data.value: You do not have permission for this action.

data.name: CreateReplaySuccess
data.value: This load plan request was already completed successfully.

data.name: RetrySameRequest
data.value: Retry without changing the form to preserve the request identity.

data.name: ErrCarrierNotFound
data.value: No active carrier with this ID was found in your scope.

data.name: ErrCarrierModeUnsupported
data.value: The carrier does not support the selected mode.

data.name: ErrShipmentNotFound
data.value: A shipment with this ID was not found in your scope.

data.name: ErrShipmentNotEligible
data.value: Only Draft or Planned shipments can be added to a load.

data.name: ErrShipmentCarrierMismatch
data.value: A shipment is already assigned to a different carrier.

data.name: ErrShipmentAlreadyAssigned
data.value: A shipment already belongs to another load.

data.name: ErrDuplicateShipment
data.value: The same shipment is listed more than once.

data.name: ErrInvalidLoadStops
data.value: Stops must be numbered 1 to N and include at least one Pickup and one Delivery.

data.name: ErrIdempotencyKeyReused
data.value: This request was already received with different values. To make a different request, close this form and open a new one.

data.name: ErrCorrelationRootMismatch
data.value: This request no longer matches the load it started. Close this form and open a new one.

data.name: ErrDependencyUnavailable
data.value: Carrier or shipment data is temporarily unavailable. Try the same request again.

data.name: ErrDependencyResponseInvalid
data.value: Carrier or shipment data could not be read. Contact support with the reference.

data.name: ErrReferenceStateUnavailable
data.value: The shipment’s current state could not be confirmed. Try the same request again later.

data.name: ErrInternalError
data.value: An unexpected error occurred. Contact support with the reference.
